from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single financial statement line item extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company that filed this document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the statement")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact name of the cash flow line item as written in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash flow (positive if provided, negative if used)")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount as indicated in the document (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions')")
    quote: str = Field(description="The verbatim text of the line containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_records: list[CashFlowRecord]
